newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Robotics begins preliminary test of x2 modem.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Robotics begins preliminary test of x2 modem.

text.p: U.S. Robotics Corp said Thursday it is launching preliminary beta testing of its next-generation x2 high-speed computer modem.

The company also said preliminary tests in 87 area codes nationwide show the majority of computer users using the x2 should be able to download text and graphics from the Internet at nearly twice the speed of current 28.8 bits per second modems connections. U.S. Robotics added it is seeking Federal Communications Commission certification for the x2.
U.S. Robotics manufactures computer modems and switches. Its shares were down 1-3/4 Thursday afternoon at 70-1/8.
